AFM Issue 1

Pursuits of Happiness • 2024

About This Issue

AFM: A Fucking Magazine is a biannual print publication exploring desire, sexuality, and relationships through essays, fiction, poetry, conversations, and visual art.

The inaugural issue, themed "Pursuits of Happiness," celebrates the many dimensions of desire, sexuality, and relationships. It functions as a physical object of desire, designed to be held, smelled, and flipped through.

The issue features contributions from notable figures including Hanif Abdurraqib, Bruce LaBruce, James Ivory, Juliana Huxtable, Sophie Mackintosh, Daphne Merkin, Allison P. Davis, and other writers, artists, and thinkers.
